steps.title: Cut & marinate the chicken
body: Cut 3 lb boneless, skinless chicken thighs into long strips.
Toss with coconut milk, curry powder, turmeric, minced garlic, brown sugar, and fish sauce until every piece is coated.
Set aside to marinate — the timer below needs at least 30 minutes, longer is fine.

steps.title: Make the peanut sauce
body: Whisk peanut butter, coconut milk, a spoon of red curry paste, fish sauce, lime juice, and brown sugar.
Thin with a splash of water until it pours off a spoon in a ribbon.
Make the full batch now — Wednesday's noodle salad reuses it as the dressing.

steps.title: Make the cucumber relish
body: Warm the rice vinegar, sugar, and a pinch of salt just until they dissolve — a minute over low heat, no need to boil.
Pour it over the sliced cucumber, shallot, chili, and cilantro.
Let it sit at room temperature while you thread the skewers.

steps.title: Thread the skewers
body: Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, alternating with chunks of bell pepper and red onion.
Thread an extra ~1 lb of chicken on its own skewers, left plain — that's the reserve for Wednesday's noodle salad, not tonight's plate.

note.text: **Toddler pull** is coming up after the grill — keep a couple of those plain skewers easy to spot.

steps.title: Preheat the grill
body: High heat, lid closed.
Slight rain risk tonight — if it's coming down, a hot cast-iron or grill pan indoors does the same job.

steps.title: Grill — first side
body: Lay all the skewers down, including the plain reserve batch.
Don't move them until the timer's done — let them actually sear.

steps.title: Flip — second side
body: Flip every skewer, marinated and plain alike.
Pull the plain reserve skewers a little early if they're browning faster than the sauced ones.

steps.title: Rest, plate, serve
body: Chicken should read 165°F at the thickest piece. Off the grill, rest 2–3 minutes.
Serve the marinated skewers over jasmine rice with peanut sauce and the cucumber relish.
Set the plain reserve skewers aside to cool, then refrigerate — Wednesday's satay noodle salad starts from there.

note.text: **Toddler pull:** a few plain-grilled pieces off the reserve skewers + rice + unvinegared cucumber, before relish and peanut sauce go on.
